patterns: APPSC asks port-location one-liners repeatedly (Krishnapatnam = Nellore asked 3+ times; Gangavaram = deep-water port; Bhogapuram near Vizag).
Current-affairs statement items on AP projects are common: Errupalem-Nambur line (timeline trap), Vijayawada station green rating (IGBC vs LEED trap), airport losses, Kadapa-Renigunta highway.
Count/rank facts: number of international airports (3), coastline rank (2nd on old 974 km; now 3rd), Vizag port traffic rank, NH-44 length.
Old-NH numbering appears (NH-9 Pune-Vijayawada); app uses new numbers (NH-65) - worth noting both.
App items lean on 2025-26 budget/progress figures (crore values, MMT, % progress) far deeper than APPSC's single-fact style.
